iconResources.interpretation: Direct resource-PNG visual review at source resource scale. Small-size UI contrast is not closed; pale fine-line icons remain a low-priority legibility check.

areaVariants.interpretation: Ten standalone/candidate backgrounds visually inspected. Candidate art only; layering/integration/adoption remains separate.

partyAXXXL.interpretation: Four actual companion portrait/context captures reviewed; actor order and actual large-text layout are bounded to those screens.

R373UI.interpretation: Scoped navigation/scroll checks: probability view now opens at its top; wardrobe opens at top and an ephemeral try keeps its prior scroll position. This is not a full UI quality acceptance.

visualReview.probabilitySheet: Viewed probability_opens_at_top.png directly: heading, close affordance, and five rates are visible. The explanatory paragraphs continue below the captured viewport; this is a scroll-length limit, not evidence that text is missing.
visualReview.wardrobeSheet: Viewed wardrobe_try_keeps_scroll.png directly: the selected Elna card and try-on state remain visible after temporary preview; controls are present. At accessibility text size, copy wraps heavily and lower cards require scrolling.
visualReview.finding: No blocking control/readability issue is demonstrated in these captures; scoped navigation fix appears effective. This does not certify all sheet content, VoiceOver, or other text sizes.

concreteRemainingWork: Inspect the 5 ambient and 5 combat VFX sequences as temporal effects; source presence alone was not judged.
Close current-build integration/legibility for static inventory icons at their actual UI scale; visual source review did not detect a broken icon but did not prove small-size contrast.
Retain motion acceptance separately: held enemy contacts cannot validate anticipation→execute→recover, hit interruption, or resolve timing.
